title: Different Bias Under Different Criteria: Assessing Bias in LLMs with a Fact-Based Approach

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses on an ambiguous coreference resolution task involving gendered pronouns (WinoBias) and an occupation selection task using gender-specific personas, comparing the selection rates to real-world occupational gender statistics.

Evaluating model responses on an occupation selection task using age-specific personas (e.g., under 44 years vs. over 45 years), comparing the selection rates to real-world occupational age statistics.
